# deed_relationship (Data Source)

Reads a relationship (merged over every asserting source) by `id`, or by `type`, `from_id` and `to_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "deed_relationship" "jellyfin_host" {
  type    = "runs_on"
  from_id = deed_entity.jellyfin.id
  to_id   = deed_entity.pve.id
}

output "asserted_by" {
  value = data.deed_relationship.jellyfin_host.sources
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from_id` (String) Source entity ID (with `type` and `to_id`).
- `id` (String) Relationship ID (`rel_…`).
- `to_id` (String) Target entity ID (with `type` and `from_id`).
- `type` (String) Relationship type (with `from_id` and `to_id`).

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (String) Merged attributes as JSON.
- `cross_project` (Boolean) Whether the endpoints are in different projects.
- `evidence_class` (String) Strongest evidence class: `declared`, `structural`, `observed` or `inferred`.
- `from` (Attributes) Source endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--from))
- `live` (Boolean) Whether at least one source currently asserts the relationship.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID of the relationship.
- `sources` (List of String) Names of the sources that currently assert the relationship.
- `to` (Attributes) Target endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--to))
